label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
verse: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
note: Don't brag about tomorrow — James says the same in his letter: 'ye know not what shall be on the morrow.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh _____.
verse: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
note: James's surprising math: trials test your faith, and the testing produces patience.

label: Sunday School
prompt: As newborn babes, desire the sincere _____ of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
verse: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
note: Peter's picture of spiritual growth: crave the word the way newborn babies crave milk.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine _____ have we given thee.
verse: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
note: David's prayer over the temple offering: we only give back what came from God's hand in the first place.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were _____; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
verse: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
note: After Saul's conversion the churches had rest and were 'edified' — built up — and multiplied.
